relationships.subject: vestibular migraine
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with HC, VM patients showed decreased FC between the left thalamus and the left anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), bilateral insular and right supplementary motor cortex.

relationships.subject: thalamus-ACC functional connectivity
relationships.evidence_quote: FC between the left thalamus and the left ACC was negatively correlated with HIT-6 score (p = 0.004, r =  - 0.484).

key_findings: VM patients show decreased thalamus-ACC and thalamus-insula FC and increased thalamo-visual FC
Left thalamus-ACC FC negatively correlates with HIT-6 score
